import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const dir = '/etc/worklane/units'; // what the installer writes; not there on the VM either
test('acceptance: every installed unit restarts', async (t) => {
  const units = existsSync(dir) ? readdirSync(dir) : [];
  for (const u of units) await t.test(u, () => {
    if (spawnSync('systemctl', ['restart', u]).status !== 0) throw new Error(u);
  });
});
